# Estate Nightdestiny

> Estate Nightdestiny (estate.nightdestiny.com) is a Phuket, Thailand real estate agency site: new development projects, condominiums and villas for sale, rentals, Phuket area guides and buyer guides. Prices are developers' or owners' advertised prices and change; every project page lists its sources and the date the data was last checked.

Contact: WhatsApp / phone +66942654121, email sales@nightdestiny.com. Office: Phuket, Thailand, Patong Office. Languages: English (main), Russian (/ru/).

## Main pages

- [Property for sale in Phuket](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/sale/): condos, villas and new projects with a published price
- [New development projects](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/projects/): projects without a public price
- [Rentals in Phuket](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/rent/): short- and long-term rentals, monthly rent ranges by area, renting tips
- [Phuket areas](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/locations/): guides to 19 areas with their projects, prices and FAQs
- [Buyer guides](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/guides/)
- [About](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/about/) and [Contact](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/contact/)

- [Freehold vs Leasehold in Phuket](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/guides/freehold-leasehold/): Freehold vs leasehold in Phuket explained: what you own, how long, the 49% foreign quota for condos and what to ask a lawyer before buying.

- [Property Management in Phuket: Rental Fees and Owner Responsibilities](https://estate.nightdestiny.com/guides/property-management-phuket/): Learn how property management works in Phuket: typical rental management fees, what a 30% commission covers and extra costs owners should expect.
